     Loganiaceæ. Bean of St. Ignatius.

     A species of strychos native to the Phillipine Islands. The tree bears a pear-shaped fruit, containing intensely bitter seed, from which is obtained the alcoholic tincture.

     Introduced and proved by Hahnemann and his provers. See Allen's Encyclopædia, vol. 5, p. 66.
